// diagnostic E3503

Jet.BuildAuthorityDenied

This root build asks for authority missing from its declaration, `#Impure` gate, or effective policy.

What

This root build asks for authority missing from its declaration, `#Impure` gate, or effective policy.

Why

Build authority must pass all three independent checks before any probe or action executes.

Fix

Declare the effect, gate the ambient operation with `#Impure("reason")`, and grant it through `--allow=Exec` for Exec (or the named effect) or package/workspace policy.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.BuildAuthorityDenied: Tests/UI/changeset_a_failed_handler_publishes_none.stderr.

Error: Jet.BuildAuthorityDenied: `meta.add`'s code writes `#Unsafe`
  --> Tests/UI/changeset_a_failed_handler_publishes_none.jet:32:22
    |
 32 |                 meta.add(refused, scope: "refused")
    |                      ^^^
 Why: Code a build hands the compiler is never audited where it lands, so it can't authorize an unsafe operation; only `#Unsafe` written in a package's own source can
 Fix: Move the unsafe operation into a function of the package's source with its own `#Unsafe("reason")` block, and call that function from the code
